name: Fenwick Stray
description: A pack of tin goods on his back that rattles when he moves. Very white teeth.

visits.greeting: Good day, good day! Lovely establishment. Lovely.

request.text: The Clerk's Companion, if it's in. For copying receipts. A man in trade has receipts coming out of his ears.

readThoughts.default: The magistrate's seal. Wax, three lines, sign.

purpose.1: Duplicates. The market inspector does love a duplicate.

source.0: A clerk I know. Former clerk.

alternative.line: Not quite the article, but I'm a flexible man.

declined.line: No offence taken. None at all.

mixedMisuse.headline: Forged receipts seized at market
mixedMisuse.text: Market inspectors have seized a quantity of receipts bearing a forged magistrate's seal. A tin-goods seller is sought to answer questions.
